rationale: Interpretation of the install-snapshot producer check (CheckRun f72f23505a56457e8735c6bc800161b0, exit 0, tests_passed, two CA_EVENT records). Parsed index 0 records the leader prepared with a snapshot at index 3 and commit index 4. Parsed index 1 shows the fresh node did install that snapshot (installed_index=3, snapshot_index=3) and was then caught up: store_last=5 with applied and commit at 5, so the store was NOT left below the snapshot index, store_emptied is false and should_snapshot is false. The AddVoter configuration entry and the entries replicated immediately afterwards refill the log above the installed snapshot index before the sample, so this route does not exhibit the underflow as constructed. I record the refutation for this construction, note that the emptied state may exist only in the window between the install and the next AppendEntries (unobserved), and keep the asserted defect unchanged on its own witness.

interpretations.rationale: Predicate for this construction: a fresh node that receives an InstallSnapshot ends with its log store below its snapshot index, so shouldSnapshot reports true. Parsed index 1 contradicts it: the install happened (snapshot_index=3, installed_index=3) and the node's log store last index was 5 against that snapshot index, with applied and commit at 5, so store_emptied=false and should_snapshot=false. The reason is visible in the same record: AddVoter appended a configuration entry after the snapshot (leader commit index 4 with snapshot index 3) and replication continued, so the follower's log was repopulated above the installed snapshot index before the sample was taken. The underflow therefore needs the node to be quiescent after the install, which this construction does not provide. The comparison is violated and this route is refuted as constructed; the asserted defect keeps its own witness.
limitations: The sample was taken after catch-up, so it cannot exclude a transient emptied state between the InstallSnapshot and the first following AppendEntries; the observation bounds what persists, not what existed momentarily.

The construction adds the node with AddVoter, which necessarily appends a configuration entry above the snapshot index; a construction that first adds the node, then disconnects it, applies and snapshots on the leader, and finally reconnects would be needed to observe a quiescent install.

One execution, one process, in-process transport, in-memory stores; the leader's TrailingLogs=0 was used to force log-based catch-up to fail, so the leader's own compaction differs from the default configuration.

This narrows reachability only: the earlier asserted defect (redundant snapshot at an unchanged index after a TrailingLogs=0 snapshot) and its bounds are unchanged, and its snapshot-install limitation now records this measured negative.
